$Comment: The most bonus a track gain takes from the TrackGain stats, in whole percent points (1000 lets a gain grow to eleven times). This file's Max is the ceiling every player starts with: a server retunes it by shipping a same-id file, and an item's StatModifiers raise or lower it for its wearer like any stat. It bounds the summed TrackGain stats alone, never the boosts, which keep their own cap.
